title: OZONOXY 100 Pro

shortDesc: Professional compact ozone generator with 100 g/h output. Treatable room volume up to 650 m³.
description: OZONOXY 100 Pro is a professional compact ozone generator with 100 g/h output. Treated room volume: 1500-3500 m3. Total disinfection up to 1500 m³, medium-level treatment up to 3500 m³.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Stainless-steel enclosure used in medicine and the food industry
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
